name: MindTranslator
author: LunarNetwork
description: Translates chat messages in place: pick the language your messages are translated to, the language you write in, and the language incoming messages are translated to. Client-side only; works on any server. Prevents double translation with an invisible marker protocol, includes a passive mode for servers that already translate (e.g. foo-client servers), and runs alongside Mindustry Tool. Fully configurable in-game via the gear button in the top-left corner.
